choose.when:
insert into wf_deploy_extension_snapshot (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, extension_key, extension_version_id, version_no, extension_type, implementation_key, config_json, version_checksum, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) values
(#{snapshot.deployId}, #{snapshot.processKey}, #{snapshot.elementId}, #{snapshot.extensionKey}, #{snapshot.extensionVersionId}, #{snapshot.versionNo}, #{snapshot.extensionType}, #{snapshot.implementationKey}, #{snapshot.configJson}, #{snapshot.versionChecksum}, #{snapshot.snapshotChecksum}, #{snapshot.createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
choose.otherwise: insert into wf_deploy_extension_snapshot (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, extension_key, extension_version_id, version_no, extension_type, implementation_key, config_json, version_checksum, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) select '', '', '', '', 0, 0, 'JAVA', '', '{}', repeat('0', 64), repeat('0', 64), '', current_timestamp(3) where 1 = 0

mapper.select: select snapshot_id, deploy_id, process_key, element_id, extension_key, extension_version_id, version_no, extension_type, implementation_key, config_json, version_checksum, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time from wf_deploy_extension_snapshot where deploy_id = #{deployId} order by process_key, element_id
